Defining the Mechanics of Authority
AUTHORITY
The Imposition of the will
of another upon ours.
The Subordination of
the receiving party.
Because these words sound bad, the anti-authoritarians wish to magically dispense with

AUTHORITY
, COMMISSION

The Rebuttal
When confronted with the necessity of
industrial organization, anti-authoritarians
concede the mechanism but claim:
It is not the case of authority which we confer on
our delegates, but of a commission entrusted!
Engels' Verdict
Changing the names of things does not
•O change the things themselves.
This is a profound mockery of the working class.

Absolute Autonomy
(Impossible in modernity)
The Relativity of Authority
Material Conditions
Dictate Position
Absolute Authority
(Abstract extreme)
Authority and autonomy are not absolute
moral binaries (Good vs. Evil).
They are relative spheres that shift dynamically
with the various phases of societal development.
Authority is imposed upon us independently of social organization;
it is bound strictly to the material conditions under which we produce.
!. The Compromise: If autonomists simply wanted to restrict authority strictly to the limits required
by production, a mutual understanding would be possible. Instead, they fight the word itself.

THE ULTIMATE AUTHORITARIAN ACT
The Paradox: To demand the
immediate abolition of
authority is to demand the
impossibility of revolution.
A revolution is certainly the most authoritarian
thing there is; it is the act whereby one part of the
population imposes its will upon the other part by
means of rifles, bayonets and cannon...
• Historical Proof: The Paris
Commune would not have
lasted a single day had it not
used the authority of the
armed people against the
bourgeois.
